body:
Found while auditing every compositor-property animation in `frontend/src/`
(the SVG-target compositing sweep, PR fix/spa-svg-animation-main-thread).

COUNTED FROM THE FILES, 2026-08-18, by matching every class whose rule carries
`animation: … infinite` and then checking whether a
`@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` block in the same module sets
`animation: none` for it. Eight modules carry an infinite animation.

Seven of them are LOADING SPINNERS. Four switch off under reduced motion:

- `frontend/src/components/DiscoverSection.module.css` — `.spin`
- `frontend/src/pages/Catalog.module.css` — `.refreshIconSpin`
- `frontend/src/pages/CoverPicker.module.css` — `.spin`
- `frontend/src/pages/Duplicates.module.css` — `.spinning`

Three do NOT:

- `frontend/src/components/Spinner.module.css` — `.ring`
  (`spin 0.7s linear infinite`). This is the SHARED `<Spinner>` / `<SpinnerCentered>`
  component — the most widely used loading indicator in the SPA — so it is the
  biggest of the three, not a corner case.
- `frontend/src/pages/Reader.module.css` — `.spin` (`spin 0.9s linear infinite`)
- `frontend/src/pages/Upload.module.css` — `.spin` (`spin 0.9s linear infinite`)

The eighth module is `frontend/src/components/HelpBanner.module.css` — `.arrow`,
the announcement-banner nudge. It is NOT a loading spinner and it DOES honour
reduced motion; it is listed here only so the count above is reproducible.

An earlier version of this entry said "six modules, four honour, two do not".
That was wrong twice: it counted HelpBanner as a spinner module, and it missed
`components/Spinner.module.css` entirely — i.e. it missed the single most-used
spinner in the app. Corrected 2026-08-18 by deriving the lists from the files
rather than from memory of the sweep.

Not fixed in that PR on purpose: whether a *loading* spinner should stop under
reduced-motion is a product call, not a mechanical one (a still spinner conveys
less state), and that PR is a perf change that must not smuggle in a behaviour
change. But the fork is currently inconsistent with itself in both directions,
which is the part that is certainly wrong. Pick one rule and apply it to all
seven.
title: SPA loading spinners: 4 of 7 honour prefers-reduced-motion, 3 do not (incl. the shared Spinner)
